_about: Source of truth for which PHNEWS issues have shipped (STYLE-RULES R127/R128). The public archive index may only list issues with status=shipped whose date is before the current week's issue (style_rules.current_issue()). Add a shipped row only after the blast (or web-only publish) has gone out, and add that issue to the archive the following week from the as-sent HTML. Never invent as-sent copy. The current week's issue stays out until the following week.
